data.text:
Short story: The day of Fabel Fun day, we had an itinerary that we were supposed to follow going around Bkk, but I told my Gf I wanted to see P'@malisorn00 even for a couple of seconds.. coz I know she will definitely say hi and bye to the fans waiting outside the venue. My Girl was hesitant at first coz she was thinking we won't have enough time that day or enought time to travel and be there on time to see P'Faye and the team go out of the venue. So we had a small fight- coz I really really wanna see P'Faye before going back to the Philippines. 

Cut the story short- we went, we booked Grab Motorbike for each of us coz Bangkok traffic was dreadful 🥹. 

Fast forward- she arrived at Sand Haus Badminton Club just on time P'Faye and Fabel team was going out- literally going down the stairs!! ( See Video below ).
And I was still at the motorbike 4 mins away!!! 😭😭😭 In the end I was not lucky enough to see.P'Faye. 

Dang my luck that day!!

#FayePeraya
#ฝ้ายพีรญา

There is good vehicular movement from the Adekunle intersection on the Third Mainland Bridge through to Adeniji Adele Road, Ilubirin, Sura Junction, and along the stretch leading to Obalende Bridge, inward Onikan and descending by Flag House en route to CMS Bridge and UBA, connecting Apongbon.

Traffic flow remains smooth from the Apongbon Bridge descending toward Outer Marina, inward CMS, and onward to the train station.
The route from NITEL Junction to the State House, inward McWen Bridge by Officers Mess and down to Bonny Camp, also shows steady movement.

Similarly, vehicles ascending the Obalende Bridge toward Dolphin Intersection and the Emergency Point, inward Ilubirin and down to Carter Bridge, exiting to link back to Third Mainland Bridge and continuing the inward journey to Iyana Oworo, are experiencing a free flow of traffic.

There are no impediments reported at this time, and our officers are on ground effectively managing the flow.
